title: fix(plugin-detail): an inline edit of a date-only field saves the picked day, not local midnight as a UTC instant (objectui#12206)
body:
Fixes #12206
Clause-②: no

## What changed

`InlineFieldInput` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`) is the inline editor that the record highlights strip and the details body share. Its date branch routes `date` and `datetime` fields to `DateField`, whose control hands back `YYYY-MM-DD`. The branch re-emitted that as `new Date(day + 'T00:00:00').toISOString()`, which is local midnight as a UTC instant. The server keeps a date-only field's UTC calendar day, so every user east of UTC saved the day before.

- **`date` arm:** the picked `YYYY-MM-DD` is now passed through unchanged. That is the shape the Edit form writes (its `date` widget is the same `DateField`) and the shape `@object-ui/core`'s native-date adapters keep for `date`.
- **`datetime` arm:** unchanged, as the claim requires. A one-line comment says why the two arms differ.
- Changed: the `onChange` of the `DateField` in the date branch, plus its comment. No export, prop or type change. The read side (`toDateInputValue` / `DateField`) is not touched.

The fix is in the producer, the date branch of `packages/plugin-detail/src/InlineFieldInput.tsx`, where the claim expected it. The details body (`DetailSection`) renders the same `InlineFieldInput`, so its inline date edit had the same defect and is fixed by the same line.

## Measured before the fix (the new pins, run against `9646e2e`'s editor)

These are the PATCH bodies (`dataSource.update` patch) for picking 2026-10-16 in the highlights strip, through `HeaderHighlight` and `InlineEditSaveBar`:

| zone | old patch | new patch |
|---|---|---|
| `Asia/Taipei` (UTC+8) | `{"due_date":"2026-10-15T16:00:00.000Z"}` (the card's row, exactly) | `{"due_date":"2026-10-16"}` |
| `America/Bogota` (UTC-5) | `{"due_date":"2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z"}` | `{"due_date":"2026-10-16"}` |
| UTC (suite zone) | `{"due_date":"2026-10-16T00:00:00.000Z"}` | `{"due_date":"2026-10-16"}` |

## Zone 2 readings

- **H1 (holds).** The defect is the single `onChange` line named in the claim. The save path passes the value through unchanged: `HeaderHighlight` / `DetailSection` call `inline.setField(name, v)`. `InlineEditContext.setField` spreads the value into `draft` as is. `InlineEditSaveBar` hands that `draft` to `dataSource.update(object, id, draft, { ifMatch })`. The Edit form's `date` widget (`getLazyFieldWidget('date')`, from the loaders the form registers) emits the plain day at both offsets. That is the control in the pin file.
- **H2, `datetime` (measured; left unchanged, as ruled).** A `datetime` field edited inline also gets the day-only `input type=date`, and this is a defect. Measured with a throwaway probe (forked child, not committed) on the current `datetime` arm:
  - The control shows the stored instant's **UTC** date. In `Asia/Taipei`, `2026-10-15T20:00:00.000Z` (local 16 Oct, 04:00) shows `2026-10-15`.
  - Picking a day replaces the stored time of day with local midnight. A stored `2026-02-14T14:46:20.862Z`, set to 1 March, writes `2026-03-01T00:00:00.000Z` (UTC), `2026-02-28T16:00:00.000Z` (UTC+8) and `2026-03-01T05:00:00.000Z` (UTC-5). The 14:46 is lost in every zone.
  - For comparison, the Edit form's `DateTimeField` (`datetime-local`) keeps the time: it writes `2026-03-01T14:46:00.000Z` in all three zones.
  - The sub-grid already handles this class for its own cells (objectui#3569, per `GridField`'s header comment).
  - Reported for the seat to file. See Acceptance notes.
- **H3 (holds).** The repo pins date behaviour under a real offset with the forks-pool driver `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`. In the normal `threads` run, `process.env.TZ` does not move the zone. Each pin file therefore gates its zone cases on `OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD=1`, and each zone opens with a rig case: the resolved `Intl` zone, and the local hour of a fixed instant. The new pin uses that mechanism and is registered in the driver's `PINS`. Without the registration the zone cases are skipped everywhere. **That one line is outside the claim's listed file surface.** See Deviations.
- **H4 (no other inline writer shares the line).** Searched source for `T00:00:00` / local-midnight re-emits. `InlineFieldInput` is the only hit, and the following were read:
  - The grid's inline cell editor (`ObjectGrid` `renderCellEditor`) goes through `FieldEditWidget` to `DateField`. `onChange` is forwarded unchanged and the plain day is staged.
  - `FieldEditWidget`'s `date` path, also used by the kanban required-fields dialog, is the same widget with the same forwarding.
  - `data-table`'s built-in date editor stores `e.target.value` for `date` and `fromDateTimeInputValue` for `datetime`.
  - The sub-grid (`GridField`) stores the raw `YYYY-MM-DD` for `date`.
  - The highlights compact layout renders `InlineFieldInput`, so it shares the line and is fixed here.

## Tests

- New file `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/InlineFieldInput.dateOnlyWriteZone-12206.test.tsx` drives the record-page write: `HeaderHighlight`, then the shared draft, then `InlineEditSaveBar`, then `dataSource.update`. It asserts the patch is exactly `{ due_date: '2026-10-16' }`.
  - A suite-zone case runs in the normal run.
  - Under `OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD=1`, each zone has a rig, the pin and the Edit-form control: `Asia/Taipei` (UTC+8) and `America/Bogota` (UTC-5, no DST).
- `InlineFieldInput.test.tsx`: the old case asserted that a `date` field re-emits an ISO timestamp, which was the defect. It now asserts the plain day. The ISO-shape assertion moved to a `datetime` case, where it still holds.
- **Ablation**, run after the fix was committed (`080bfdc`) with `ablation-replace.mjs` and an EXIT/INT/TERM restore trap:
  - The mutation `onChange(isDateTime && v ? new Date` became `onChange(v ? new Date`. On disk the anchor count went 1 to 0 and the blob changed.
  - The forks-pool run then went red as expected, with 4 failed and 13 passed. The failures were the suite-zone save, the UTC+8 save (received `2026-10-15T16:00:00.000Z`), the UTC-5 save (received `2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z`) and the `InlineFieldInput.test.tsx` date case. The rigs, the Edit-form controls and the `datetime` case stayed green.
  - The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - A first attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran, because the replacement was a substring of the anchor. Nothing was measured on that attempt.

| gate | result |
|---|---|
| `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' --concurrency=2` (verify lock) | 11/11 successful (cache hits) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (script echoed: `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFilesOnly` confirms both test files are in the test project) | exit 0 |
| targeted vitest: 23 files (`InlineFieldInput*`, `HeaderHighlight*`, `InlineEditSaveBar*`, `DetailSection.inlineEdit` / `multiValueInlineEdit`, `inlineEditType*`, `inlineCredentialGate`, the new pin) | 23 files passed; 322 passed, 6 skipped (the 6 zone-gated cases) |
| `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` (forks child over every registered pin, now 27) | 28 passed |
| new pin file, forks pool, `OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD=1` | 7 passed |
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:control-bytes` | exit 0 each |
| `check:new-line-citations` | `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0, declares `.changeset/12206-inline-date-only-day.md` |
| eslint on the 4 touched files (`--no-inline-config`) | 0 errors; 42 warnings, all in `InlineFieldInput.tsx`, the same count as at base |

NOT MEASURED: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` (both CI-owned), and a live-browser rerun on HotCRM.

## Deviations

- **File surface:** one line added to the `PINS` list in `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts`. It registers the new pin, which is how the H3 mechanism runs the zone cases at all. Nothing else in that file changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Finding, class (a): `datetime` inline edit on the record page.** The highlights strip and the details body use a day-only control for `datetime` fields. It shows the instant's UTC date, and any pick replaces the stored time of day with local midnight (see H2). Not changed here, per the ruling.
